policy.statement: Where upstream actions_processed implies a bind for an action, adopt the upstream set restricted to candidate face/shoulder/trigger buttons; Bryan observed upstream was almost always right in the cases he reviewed. Adopted cases he did not individually confirm are marked pending_final_human_review. Videos without upstream coverage keep the v3.1 inference or its per-action prior fallback. v1451209819:dash is the union of both selections per his explicit verdict.
